messages:
Aisha (procurement): Received run of H100s from VendorZ — some units arrived with thermal damage. opening thread to coordinate RMA + reallocation. AWB 1Z999AA0000000000. partial DOA suspected. Please advise next steps.
Jordan (ops): Ugh. How many affected? region?
Aisha (procurement): Initial count from dock: 4/12 visibly damaged, 2 more failing POST. Affected batch destined for eu-west-1 dedicated pool.
Felix (logistics): Pls hold all 12 in quarantine at FRA depot. Do not kitting / redistribute. I'll take photos and serial snapshot. Serial samples: H100-SN: H100-FF12, H100-FF13, H100-FF14 (more in doc).
Maya (vendor-relations): VendorZ on the line — they acknowledge transit damage. Asking whether we want immediate air-replace (expedite) or depot RMA (slower). They quoted expedited replacement at +$4,500/unit and ETA 48h; depot repair 10-14 days no uplift.
Jordan (ops): For production impact: we need 8 H100s in eu-west-1 this week. Can we fall back to hosted or dedicated burst in another region? Costed options?
Aisha (procurement): Hosted fallback will increase inference cost by ~18% and risk latency. Ops: will temporary cross-region routing be acceptable?
Jordan (ops): Not ideal for SLOs. Prioritize expedited for the 8 units that are live-bound. Accept depot RMA for the rest. Confirm quantity: expedite 8, depot 4 (includes the 4 visibly damaged).
Maya (vendor-relations): I'll push that. Vendor asks for return labels + serial confirmation before air dispatch. They can provide prepaid AWB and e-labels once we provide final serial list.
Felix (logistics): I'll upload serial CSV and attach depot photos to the ticket. Want return labels sent to FRA depot address: Redwood FRA DC 3, Dock 7.
RMA-bot: Created RMA 2026-43321 for AWB 1Z999AA0000000000. Label URL: https://vendorz.example/label/1Z/2026-43321 (expires 7d). Status: pending
Maya (vendor-relations): VendorZ asks also for insurance claim — they need incident time & photos. Felix pls confirm if you want vendor to file claim on our behalf or we file with carrier.
Felix (logistics): We prefer vendor files (faster) but need their confirmation. I'll attach photos and give them permission.
Aisha (procurement): On pricing: vendor offered 8 expedited @ +$4.5k = $36k uplift. Approve emergency spend up to $40k? finance ok?
Jordan (ops): Approve. Also opening ENG ticket ENG-12345 to reserve loaner pool (8 units) in eu-west-1 until replacements arrive. @oncall please be aware of potential capacity shifts.
Maya (vendor-relations): Vendor confirmed they'll prep labels and air ship once serials are posted. ETA target 48h for 8 units. Will update RMA-bot once shipped.
Jordan (ops): Thanks — please ping when AWBs are created. I'll choreograph rollback/fallback with traffic routing in Console.
Aisha (procurement): Thanks all. Felix, tag me when CSV uploaded. Closing loop: prefer vendor file insurance claim; expedite 8, depot RMA 4, prepay labels from vendor. :thumbsup:
RMA-bot: RMA 2026-43321 status updated -> labels generated. AWB provisional 1Z999AA0000001234 for expedite shipment.
Maya (vendor-relations): noted and will follow up if vendor needs any PO amendment.
Jordan (ops): I'll keep the cluster teams posted. End of thread.
